get.description: Returns the programme with the specified ID.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the programme you want to retrieve.

parameters.name: WithAccountData
parameters.description: Specifies if the response should include account data.

parameters.name: WithTrustMethodName
parameters.description: Specifies if the response should include the trust method name.

parameters.name: WithVerificationMethodDetails
parameters.description: Specifies if the response should include the verification method details.

200.description: A successful response with a programme.

400.description: The request was unacceptable, often due to missing a required parameter.

404.description: The requested resource does not exist.

get.description: Returns a list of available programmes you can use for payment requests. The returned programmes are sorted by creation date, with the most recent programmes appearing first.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: Filters retrieved programmes by their status.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: Specifies the number of items to return per page.

parameters.name: ContinuationToken
parameters.description: A continuation token used for pagination, returned if *HasMore* is true. You can use the value of *ContinuationToken* in a following call to fetch the next page of results.

200.description: A dictionary with a *Data* property that contains an array of programmes up to *PageSize*, with programmes starting after *ContinuationToken* when specified. Each entry in the array is a separate programme object. If no more programmes are available, the resulting array is empty.

get.description: Returns the payment request with the specified ID.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the payment request you want to retrieve.

200.description: A successful response with payment request.

400.description: The request was unacceptable, often due to missing a required parameter.

404.description: The requested resource does not exist.

get.description: Returns a list of your payment requests.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: Specifies the number of items to return per page.

parameters.name: ContinuationToken
parameters.description: A continuation token used for pagination, returned if *HasMore* is true. You can use the value of *ContinuationToken* in a following call to fetch the next page of results.

200.description: A successful response with all payment requests.

post.description: Creates a payment request in the Vitesse Platform by initiating a payment transaction with the specified parameters.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique identifier for the request, used to prevent duplicate requests. Use a unique string up to 255 characters long.

200.description: A successful response with identifier of created payment request.

400.description: The request was unacceptable, often due to missing a required parameter.

put.description: Cancels the payment request with the specified ID in the Vitesse Platform.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the payment request you want to cancel.

200.description: A successful response with payment request status.

400.description: The request was unacceptable, often due to missing a required parameter.

404.description: The requested resource does not exist.

409.description: The request conflicts with another request (perhaps due to using the same idempotent key).

SendAccountId.description: The ID of the funding account from which you want to send funds.

PaymentMethod.description:
An optional route type to specify the type of payment. Valid values are the following:
  • *BankAccount*
  • *PostalCheque*
  • *Echeck*
  • *Card*

SendValue.description: The amount you want to send in the currency defined in *SendCurrency*. You can use *ReceiveValue* instead, but not both.

SendCurrency.description: The currency in which you want to make the transaction. Use an ISO 4217 currency code, for example, GBP.

ReceiveValue.description: The amount you want the recipient to receive in *ReceiveCurrency*. You can use *SendValue* instead, but not both.

ReceiveCurrency.description: The currency you want the recipient to receive, specified as an ISO 4217 currency code.

UseFxRateGroup.description: Specifies whether to use FX rate group for the transaction.If *true*, the rate group is used to calculate the exchange rate. If *false*, the rate group is not used.
